caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden bench with a high straight back composed of vertical wooden panels. The bench has two wide, flat armrests that curve outward at the ends and extend to the floor as the sides of the bench, ending in a slightly outward-curving foot for stability. There is an additional central support leg beneath the seat, echoing the shape of the armrest supports. The wood is depicted in shades of light to medium brown, with visible grain patterns throughout. The bench is shown isolated against a plain, light beige background with no other objects present. The drawing is drafted with attention to the texture and construction details of the wood.
title: Church Pew
